title: Home
headingSearch: Find what you need on a site.
introInspect: EXEGEZIS walks the site in clean browsers, repeats every visit and only marks as verified what appears in every repetition, with its evidence and a Playwright spec.
introSearch: Exact words (no AI, checked on every load) or by meaning (the AI proposes and every quote is checked letter by letter on the page). You always see how many pages were searched.
haveSymptom: Do you have a specific symptom? Open an investigation

proven.title: What has been proven
proven.note: One value per case (its latest real result). Runs with recorded answers (replay) do not count.

metrics.verifiedBugsHint: {reproductions, plural, one {# reproduction} other {# reproductions}} · {attempts, plural, one {# browser run} other {# browser runs}}
metrics.validatedCausesHint: against the alternatives tested, in {cases, plural, one {# case} other {# cases}}
metrics.falseValidations: {count, plural, one {# false validation} other {# false validations}}
metrics.falseVerifiedHint: out of {count, plural, one {# negative case evaluated} other {# negative cases evaluated}}
metrics.medianNone: no timings: archived results do not keep reproduction.json
metrics.medianHint: over {count, plural, one {# verified bug} other {# verified bugs}} (all runs)

cases.title: Activity per case
cases.negativeNoEvidence: A negative case has no bug to prove
cases.replayTitle: Recorded planner answer (mock): not a live AI result
cases.replaysTitle: {count, plural, one {# run with recorded planner answers, not counted in the metrics} other {# runs with recorded planner answers, not counted in the metrics}}

recent.title: Recent inspections
recent.none: You have not inspected any site yet
recent.noneBody: Type a URL above. The result will appear here with its verified findings.
recent.line: {problems, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} · {elements, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}} · {when}

inspect.expired: The saved session for <origin></origin> has expired. Renew it in <link>Settings → Access</link> before inspecting, or tick “Inspect as an anonymous visitor” in the advanced options.
inspect.willUse: The saved access for <origin></origin> ({kinds}) will be used, in strict read-only.
inspect.confirm: I confirm that I may inspect <host></host>.
inspect.readonlyNote: The inspection is read-only: it does not submit forms or press buttons.
inspect.storageState: storageState (path to a Playwright session file on this computer; its content is not shown or kept in the report)
inspect.strict: Strict read-only: also block the writes the page itself makes. Those pages are marked degraded and their findings are discarded.
inspect.ignoreRobots: Ignore robots.txt (the start URL is always visited; robots.txt only limits discovery).
inspect.anonymous: Inspect as an anonymous visitor: do not use the saved access for this site (session, HTTP user or WAF token).

mode.exactHelp: No AI. Finds the words as they are (ignoring accents and case) and checks every result in every load.
mode.meaningHelp: The AI reads the text and suggests passages. Every quote is checked letter by letter on the page; those that are not there are discarded.
mode.templateHelp: Prepared searches (health, personal data, past dates…) and yours.

search.termsHelp: Separate with commas. <phrase></phrase> in quotes · <exclude></exclude> excludes the block of text where it appears. Accents and case do not matter; ñ counts (año ≠ ano).
search.suggestInfo: The AI ({model}) will suggest words of the same family and synonyms. Only your terms are sent, never the site's text. Estimated cost: up to {usd}.
search.suggestNoKey: Suggestions need the AI key (EXEGEZIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the repository's .env file).
search.pick: Tick the ones you want to use. The search is still exact.
search.variants: Include variants (plurals and verb forms: disease → diseases, cure → cured). Every result by variant says why it matched. It can join different words (house/housing) and does not join derived ones (cure/curation): for those, use the suggestions.
search.excludePage: With -word, exclude the whole page (by default only the block). The report always says how much was excluded.
search.meaningPlaceholder: any mention of medicine, direct or indirect
search.withMeaning: Also include the meaning part (uses AI, with a cost estimate). Unticked, only the exact part: no AI.
search.estimate: Estimate before reading the site: up to ≈ {usd} for {pages} pages with {model}. The exact figure is calculated after reading them; if it exceeds the limit ({limit}, in Settings → Searches), the AI is not called and you are asked to approve it.
search.noKey: Meaning search needs the AI key: add EXEGEZIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the repository's .env file.
search.chipLoads: {count, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} per page
search.chipHidden: includes text that is not visible
search.confirm: I confirm that I may review <host></host>.
search.readonlyNote: The search is read-only: it does not submit forms or press buttons.
search.includeHidden: Include text that is not visible (closed accordions, hidden tabs, alt/title attributes, metadata). It is marked “not visible”.
search.anonymous: Search as an anonymous visitor: do not use the saved access of this site.
search.ignoreRobots: Ignore robots.txt (the start URL is always visited).
